title: Freeze bounded callable-constraint design
conditions: Production implementation may not start until termination, ownership, diagnostics, fact preservation, allocation, and invalidation evidence are frozen.
goal: Freeze one terminating callable-constraint worklist, ownership model, and executable recomputation evidence.
description: Scope: the complete OPT-E bounded callable-constraint design and acceptance artifacts. Context: TypeInfer contains unification, fixed-point reduction, SCC ordering, and concrete solving in one large path, while representation and resource-handle facts must remain authoritative. Target: select the smallest consolidation that bounds recomputation, preserves diagnostics and BindingInfo facts, and does not broaden the constraint vocabulary. Design Considerations: compare indexed worklists, union-find, memoization, and SCC strategies with mature solvers and the local pattern catalog. Design Value: deterministic convergence and lower repeated work without a second type system. Constraints & Risks: no new generics, resource typestate, handle erasure, diagnostic reordering, or compatibility solver.

decisions.algorithms: to be frozen after indexed worklist, union-find, memoization, and SCC comparison
decisions.data_structures: bounded queues, canonical substitutions, and origin-preserving constraints
decisions.state: StyioSemaContext retains binding, handle, and representation ownership
decisions.isolation: design and executable acceptance artifacts only
decisions.concurrency: OPT-E is independent of OPT-D; OPT-F waits for this handoff

test_seams: solver statistics and allocation benchmark probes

acceptance_criteria.text: Architecture and Validation freeze termination, ownership, origin/diagnostic ordering, handle and representation preservation, cache invalidation, allocation, and recomputation evidence.
The design pattern assessment compares the simplest direct solution with applicable catalog patterns and records a concrete acceptance proof.

title: Implement the bounded callable-constraint worklist
goal: Replace repeated callable-constraint rescans with one deterministic bounded worklist while preserving existing type facts and diagnostics.
description: Closure: module - callable constraint reduction and solving. Context: the existing reduction loop repeatedly scans unresolved constraints and shares ownership with monotype unification and SCC inference. Target: implement the Designer-frozen indexed worklist or equivalent bounded algorithm as the only callable-constraint reducer, with deterministic origin order and measurable recomputation counts. Design Considerations: near-linear scheduling, canonical substitution ownership, no duplicate solving, stable error origins, and explicit invalidation. Design Value: makes termination and cost observable without inventing a parallel semantic layer. Constraints & Risks: preserve BindingInfo handle/dynamic/list representation facts, current constraint vocabulary, defaulting behavior, and public diagnostics; no compatibility solver.

interfaces.name: callable constraint solver
interfaces.outputs: canonical substitutions, residual constraints, or deterministic TypeError

decisions.composition: one reducer and one canonical unifier
decisions.algorithms: bounded indexed worklist with SCC order retained
decisions.data_structures: deque, dependency index, canonical substitution mapping, monotonic solved set
decisions.state: StyioSemaContext remains fact owner; no copied handle/repr truth
decisions.concurrency: solver is request-local and has no shared mutable state

acceptance_criteria.text: The solver terminates under a frozen bound, avoids whole-set rescans, and preserves stable constraint-origin diagnostics.
All existing numeric, comparable, indexable, transitive, recursive, defaulting, handle, and representation facts remain equivalent.
The superseded repeated-scan path is removed with no compatibility solver, and allocation/recomputation evidence meets the frozen budget.

title: Validate bounded callable-constraint solving
conditions: Immediate decision issues must be resolved; deferred decisions remain collected for the final OPT-D-G handoff.
goal: Review OPT-E once and run its complete impacted type-solver, diagnostic, and bounded-resource regression.
description: Scope: the complete bounded callable-constraint group. Context: group completion requires one fresh end-to-end review followed by one impacted regression. Target: prove termination, canonical ownership, stable diagnostics, preserved handle/representation facts, and bounded recomputation. Design Considerations: inspect the changed Sema solver and directly impacted fixtures only. Design Value: closes OPT-E as one coherent solver boundary ready for OPT-F consumption. Constraints & Risks: one Reviewer only; no new constraint vocabulary or repeat full regression without failure evidence.

decisions.composition: one group review then one impacted regression
decisions.isolation: OPT-E changed paths and impacted Sema tests

acceptance_criteria.text: No unresolved immediate decision issue remains and the Reviewer confirms the frozen OPT-E boundary.
All impacted callable-constraint, inferred-generic, Sema-internal, benchmark smoke, and documentation gates pass once.
